post.title: Detached Garage Marysville WA — Permits, Setbacks, Foundations, Power and Building It Right
post.description: A Marysville detached garage guide: when the City's building permit applies, MMC 22C.180 setbacks, height and footprint limits, slab and framing, Snohomish PUD power, electrical permits and hiring.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-24 packets (latest openclaw-seo-2026-11-23); PC not touched.
